lines.text: # SQLite sidecars are runtime state, never source.  Global by design: any
# *.sqlite database can grow a -wal/-shm/-journal next to it.

broken?.finding: nothing was broken - all three sidecar rules are already unanchored/global and already cover a sidecar at ROOT and at DEPTH
evidence: rules at .gitignore:20-22 have no leading '/' and no directory component -> _pattern_is_global() True

git check-ignore -v --no-index ignores state.sqlite-wal (root) AND orchestration/units/state.sqlite-shm AND src/resextract/state.sqlite-journal (depth 2 and 3), attributing each match to .gitignore:20/21/22 - not to a parent-directory rule

the only other rule that could match a sidecar transitively, /state/ at .gitignore:7, is root-anchored; probe parents src, src/resextract, orchestration, orchestration/units all return rc=1 (not ignored)
no root-anchored-only form (/state.sqlite-wal or state/state.sqlite-wal) exists to replace, so there is nothing for U8.70's 'add the global form' treatment to add
broken?.what_was_actually_missing: coverage - the rules were untested, so nothing stopped them being re-anchored or deleted; the guard is what this unit added

gitignore_change.note: none - rules already global; .gitignore left byte-identical (git diff --exit-code -- .gitignore clean; sha256 27f4f10aa11a8217afd90455fb6faafa17ca204d00d44dfb14a2ab86b2ca60da matches git show HEAD:.gitignore)

new_tests.asserts: behavioural - git check-ignore --quiet --no-index exit code 0 for a root-level sidecar; plus parent '.' (no parent) is exempt from the transitive-check; plus REPO_ROOT/'state.sqlite-wal' does not exist on disk

behavioural - a depth-2 sidecar is ignored; parent orchestration/units is asserted NOT ignored (is_ignored False) so the pass cannot be inherited from a parent rule; plus the path does not exist on disk
behavioural - a depth-3 sidecar inside the source tree is ignored; parent src/resextract asserted NOT ignored; plus the path does not exist on disk

structural - parse of the real .gitignore (or the U874_GITIGNORE copy): some rule matches a 'state.sqlite-wal' basename AND at least one matching pattern is global (_pattern_is_global); rejects root-anchored '/state.sqlite-wal'

paths_asserted.why_outside_any_ignored_parent: none of these sits under state/**, so /state/ (root-anchored, .gitignore:7) cannot satisfy them transitively; the tests assert this internally by requiring the parent directory NOT to be ignored
paths_asserted.pre_existing_sidecars_not_asserted: tests/fixtures/dashboard-store/state.sqlite-wal and -shm already exist on disk from earlier units; they are covered by the pre-existing GENERATED_ARTIFACTS parametrisation, not by the new tests

how: in-test: every new behavioural test asserts not (REPO_ROOT / path).exists(), and green ran after the red runs

post-run shell: test -e for all six probe paths (state.sqlite-wal, orchestration/units/state.sqlite-shm, src/resextract/state.sqlite-journal, note.tmp, src/resextract/build.tmp, orchestration/units/scan.tmp) -> all absent

repo-wide: find . -path ./.git -prune -o \( -name '*.sqlite-wal' -o -name '*.sqlite-shm' -o -name '*.sqlite-journal' -o -name '*.tmp' \) -print found only pre-existing artifacts under tests/fixtures/dashboard-store/, state/logs/ and state/ (all created before this unit); no probe path appeared
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 used on every pytest run and a full __pycache__ purge at the end (find ... -name __pycache__ | wc -l -> 0)

the throwaway stub work tree state/verify/U8.76/redrepo (git init + the copy as .gitignore) was removed after the red runs; only the two mutation copies and the two red logs remain under state/verify/U8.76/**

red_green.mutation: copy of .gitignore with the three global sidecar rules (*.sqlite-wal, *.sqlite-shm, *.sqlite-journal) deleted outright; nothing on disk edited, U874_GITIGNORE points the structural parse AND (new in U8.76) the check-ignore cwd at it via a throwaway work tree state/verify/U8.76/redrepo
verbatim_failure: E       AssertionError: orchestration/units/state.sqlite-shm is not ignored; the global '*.sqlite-wal'/'-shm'/'-journal' rules (.gitignore:20-22) must cover a sidecar wherever its database lives -- at the repository root and inside the source tree, not only the spill files under state/ that /state/ already caught

E       AssertionError: /home/zer0null/reserach extarctor/state/verify/U8.76/gitignore-no-global-sidecar declares no rule that would ignore a 'state.sqlite-journal' file; the global '*.sqlite-journal' rule (.gitignore:20-22) is what keeps a runtime sidecar out of the index wherever its database lives
red_green.collateral_red: test_generated_artifacts_are_ignored_on_disk[tests/fixtures/dashboard-store/state.sqlite-wal] and [...state.sqlite-shm] also go red - a true property (deleting the rules really does un-ignore the fixture sidecars), not a false positive
red_green.then_pass: with the real .gitignore (env unset): 23 passed in 0.04s

red_green.mutation: copy of .gitignore with the three global forms rewritten root-anchored-only: '*.sqlite-wal' -> '/state.sqlite-wal', '*.sqlite-shm' -> '/state.sqlite-shm', '*.sqlite-journal' -> '/state.sqlite-journal'
new_tests_green: test_sidecar_paths_are_ignored_at_any_depth[state.sqlite-wal] - correctly green: a root-anchored '/state.sqlite-wal' DOES match a root-level sidecar; that is exactly the incomplete-coverage case the structural test names, so it is the structural test that must (and does) go red
verbatim_failure: E       AssertionError: only directory-anchored rules ['/*.sqlite-wal', '/*.sqlite-shm', '/*.sqlite-journal']; a root-anchored '/state.sqlite-wal' (or one pinned to state/) would not ignore a sidecar sitting next to a database elsewhere in the tree

E       AssertionError: orchestration/units/state.sqlite-shm is not ignored; the global '*.sqlite-wal'/'-shm'/'-journal' rules (.gitignore:20-22) must cover a sidecar wherever its database lives -- at the repository root and inside the source tree, not only the spill files under state/ that /state/ already caught

next_unit_hint: Nothing was broken in .gitignore, so the remaining gap is the open user decision U8.74 and this unit both left alone: whether the root-level database (state/state.sqlite) itself should be versioned rather than left as ignored runtime state - the same class of question already recorded for /dockets/ (.gitignore:9-14). Until the user decides, a verifier should re-run only tests/test_repo_hygiene.py (23 passed) and the two red cycles via U874_GITIGNORE against the copies under state/verify/U8.76/; no .gitignore change is expected.
